breech.definition: n. opening in the rear of the barrel of a gun where bullets can be loaded
breech.translation:
n. 后膛, 臀部
vt. 给...装上炮尾, 给...穿上裤子

breech-cloths.translation: (breech-cloth 的复数) n. 土人的腰布；短裤

breech-loading.definition: a. (of guns) designed to be loaded at the breech
breech-loading.translation: a. 后膛装填的, 后装式的

breechblock.definition: n. a metal block in breech-loading firearms that is withdrawn to insert a cartridge and replaced to close the breech before firing
breechblock.translation: n. 炮闩, 闩体, 尾栓

breechcloth.definition: n. a garment that provides covering for the loins

breechclout.definition: n. a garment that provides covering for the loins
breechclout.translation: n. 土人的腰布, 短裤

breechclouts.translation: (breechclout 的第三人称 -s形式) n. 土人的腰布, 短裤

breeched.translation: a. 穿长裤的; 穿马裤的

breeches.definition: n. trousers ending above the knee

breeching.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Breech
n. A whipping on the breech, or the act of whipping on the
   breech.
n. That part of a harness which passes round the breech of
   a horse, enabling him to hold back a vehicle.
n. A strong rope rove through the cascabel of a cannon and
   secured to ringbolts in the ship's side, to limit the recoil of the gun
   when it is discharged.
n. The sheet iron casing at the end of boilers to convey
   the smoke from the flues to the smokestack.
breeching.translation: n. (役畜的)尻带, 驻退索(发炮时阻止炮身后退的绳索)

breechloader.definition: n. a gun that is loaded at the breech
breechloader.translation: n. 后膛枪, 后膛炮

breed.definition:
n. a special variety of domesticated animals within a species
n. a special type
v. copulate with a female, used especially of horses
v. cause to procreate (animals)
breed.translation:
n. 种类, 品种
v. 养育, 引起, 饲养, 繁殖

breed true.translation: 纯种的,与原种相同;典型的

breed's hill.translation: 布里德山(美国波士顿附近的山，与邦克山毗连，美国独立战争初期的邦克山战役在此进行)

breeder.definition: n. a person who breeds animals
breeder.translation: n. 饲养员, 养育员, 起因, 起源者

breeder reactor.translation: [化] 增殖堆; 增殖反应堆

breeders.definition: n. a person who breeds animals
breeders.translation: n. （动物）饲者, 种畜( breeder的复数形式 )

breeding.definition:
n. elegance by virtue of fineness of manner and expression
n. helping someone grow up to be an accepted member of the community
n. the production of animals or plants by inbreeding or hybridization
breeding.translation:
n. 教养, 生育, 饲养
[医] 生育, 繁殖, 育种, 饲养

breeding-grounds.translation: (breeding-ground 的复数) 滋生地, 繁殖地

breeds.definition:
n a special variety of domesticated animals within a species
n a special type
v call forth
v copulate with a female, used especially of horses
v cause to procreate (animals)
v have young (animals) or reproduce (organisms)
breeds.translation: n. 品种；族类（breed的复数形式）

breen.translation:
n. 褐绿色
a. 褐绿色的

breese.translation: [人名] [英格兰人、威尔士人姓氏] 布里斯 Breeze的变体; [地名] [美国] 布里斯

breeze.definition:
n. a slight wind (usually refreshing)
v. blow gently and lightly
v. to proceed quickly and easily
breeze.translation:
n. 微风, 煤屑, 轻而易举的事
vi. 吹微风, 逃走

breeze in.translation: 象一阵风似地来到, 突然出现, 轻而易举地取胜

breeze off.translation: 住嘴不说, 离去, 走开

breeze-blocks.translation: n. 轻型建筑用砖( breeze-block的复数形式 )

breezed.definition:
v blow gently and lightly
v to proceed quickly and easily
breezed.translation: vi. 吹微风（breeze的过去式与过去分词形式）

breezeless.translation: a. 无风的, 平静的

breezes.definition:
n a slight wind (usually refreshing)
n any undertaking that is easy to do
v blow gently and lightly
v to proceed quickly and easily
breezes.translation: n. 微风, 轻风( breeze的名词复数 ); 轻而易举的事

breezeway.translation:
n. 有屋顶的通路
[电] 吹风道

breezier.definition:
s. fresh and animated
s. abounding in or exposed to the wind or breezes
breezier.translation: breezy（有微风的, 微风吹过的）的比较级形式

breeziest.definition:
s. fresh and animated
s. abounding in or exposed to the wind or breezes
breeziest.translation: breezy（有微风的, 微风吹过的）的最高级形式

breezily.translation: adv. 吹微风地, 活泼地, 轻松地

breeziness.definition:
n. a mildly windy state of the air
n. a breezy liveliness
breeziness.translation: n. 微风的轻吹, 活泼

breezing.definition:
v blow gently and lightly
v to proceed quickly and easily

breezy.translation: a. 有微风的, 通风好的, 活泼的
